## Question

Do 30-day hospital readmission rates differ by gender and race?

## Main figure

```{r}
#| label: main-figure
#| eval: false
library(tidyverse)

my_data <- read_csv("../data/tidy/your_file.csv")
# Your ggplot code here; add fig-cap and fig-alt
```

## What it shows

The figure shows that 30-day readmission rates vary across racial groups and genders. Some groups have higher readmission rates than others, but the figure only shows differences and does not explain what causes those differences.
## Limitations

The data come from a hospital readmissions dataset, with one row representing a patient hospitalization. Some racial groups have smaller sample sizes (shown by the n values in the facet labels), so their rates may be less reliable. The data cannot determine why readmission rates differ or whether factors such as age, underlying health conditions, insurance status, or access to care contributed to the outcomes.
